svg.text: SELECT result_code, response_json FROM idempotency_keys WHERE user_id = ? AND request_key = ?

INSERT INTO financial_transactions (user_id, category_id, transaction_type='EXPENSE', status='POSTED', description, currency, amount, occurred_on, posted_at) VALUES (...)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='DEBIT', amount_original, amount_base) VALUES (newTxId, expenseAccId, 'DEBIT', amount, amount)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='CREDIT', amount_original, amount_base) VALUES (newTxId, walletAccId, 'CREDIT', amount, amount)
UPDATE wallets SET cached_balance = cached_balance - ? WHERE id = ?
INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (user_id, request_key, request_hash, transaction_id, result_code=201, response_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, newTxId, 201, ...)
SELECT id, limit_amount, spent_amount, alert_level, is_yellow_sent, is_red_sent FROM budgets WHERE user_id = ? AND category_id = ? AND budget_month = ?

SELECT SUM(le.amount_base) FROM ledger_entries le JOIN financial_transactions ft ON le.transaction_id = ft.id WHERE ft.user_id = ? AND ft.category_id = ? AND ft.occurred_on BETWEEN ? AND ? AND ft.status = 'POSTED'
UPDATE budgets SET spent_amount = ?, alert_level = 'YELLOW_80', is_yellow_sent = TRUE WHERE id = ?
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, body, notification_type='BUDGET', priority='WARNING', dedup_key) VALUES (?, 'Cảnh báo Ngân sách (80%)', ?, 'BUDGET', 'WARNING', ?)
UPDATE budgets SET spent_amount = ?, alert_level = 'RED_100', is_red_sent = TRUE WHERE id = ?
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, body, notification_type='BUDGET', priority='CRITICAL', dedup_key) VALUES (?, 'Vượt Ngân sách (100%)', ?, 'BUDGET', 'CRITICAL', ?)
